implementation_rules: The CLI accepts exactly --fixture <path> and --output-dir <directory>; reject unknown, duplicate, or missing options and positional input with nonzero status and a stable diagnostic class.

Decode the fixture with SnapshotCodec and restore it with SnapshotBootstrapper into IndexedObjectStore in Loading state. Do not include semantic/src private headers, use ObjectStoreMutator, or depend on test code.

Use the restored semantic read view to populate both production RuntimeScene and production Scene at one exact generation/read token. A small CLI-private ISemanticSceneCompiler adapter may translate the already computed FullSceneCompiler projection into public CompiledSceneSnapshot/Delta values solely to feed SceneBinding/IncrementalRuntimeCoordinator; it must not become a new public compiler, duplicate bounds/geometry mathematics, or expose a final rendering shortcut.

For the initial full load, use Scene, SceneBinding, IncrementalRuntimeCoordinator recovery/full rebuild, DirectRenderScene, and UniformGridSpatialIndex. The CLI-private compiler must reuse FullSceneCompiler object IDs, order, and computed worldBounds; construct only the public SceneRecord projection frozen in authority.lock.json; and must not duplicate computeBounds/geometry logic. Require Scene and RuntimeScene generation, record membership, and bounds to agree before framing.
Acquire the frozen SurfaceSnapshot from SurfaceLifecycle and build the immutable FrameState from the frozen fixture values and published Scene/RuntimeScene identities.

Call VisibilityResolver::resolve, DirectReferenceSource::build, FramePlanBuilder::build, and FrameOrchestrator::submit with SkiaHeadlessBackend in this order. Never manually construct the final VisibilityResult, ReferenceDrawList, ReferenceTraversalEntry, ReferenceCommand, or FramePlan.
Use only SkiaHeadlessBackend's successful HeadlessRasterObservation to obtain RGBA/digest output. Do not reimplement rendering, use test fixtures, or access Skia directly in the CLI.

Write render.rgba as exact raw RGBA bytes, render-digest.txt as the exact digest plus one LF, and render-evidence.json as canonical UTF-8 JSON with stable key order, one LF, no timestamp, no absolute path, and no environment-specific value.

render-evidence.json must contain schema_version, fixture_id, fixture_sha256, frame/view/surface/metrics/scene/read-token identities, canonical/Scene/RuntimeScene/visible/draw counts, ordered object IDs at every observable stage, exact ObjectKind names for canonical/RuntimeScene/draw/backend stages, frozen coarse SceneObjectKind names for Scene, traversed_object_kinds, reference_plan_digest, raster width/height/byte count/digest, golden_sha256, exact pipeline_stages, locked Skia SDK id, and result=PASS.

Compute fixture SHA-256 and render.rgba SHA-256 in the CLI with a small tool-local dependency-free implementation or an already linked accepted library. The test/reviewer must compute these hashes independently and compare them to the checked-in oracle.

Require the requested output directory not to exist. Stage all outputs in one unique sibling directory on the same filesystem, close every file, and publish the complete set by renaming the directory to the absent requested path only after input, render, and all writes succeed. If the requested path already exists, reject before staging and preserve it byte-for-byte. Remove staging best-effort on all failures.

The expected descriptor is read-only oracle input. The executable may compare against it only when the test supplies it independently; ordinary CLI operation must not generate, overwrite, or self-bless expected values.
Use only the existing r1-full-v1 macos-arm64-metal/release SDK consumer path for this executor. Do not run Skia GN/Ninja, modify lock/profile files, or select a fallback SDK.

Do not alter any G2 or G3-01 through G3-06 source/header/test contract. Do not implement CanonicalVisible, FrameCoverageManifest, Arc, camera interaction, hit/select, platform hosts, scheduler, Tile/cache, or G3-08+ behavior.
